expectations.buyer: Renewable-energy developers, auction bidders, lenders, EPC contractors, component suppliers, and public auction authorities
expectations.pain: A bid wins on non-price resilience, origin, or cybersecurity promises that are later difficult to evidence through procurement, construction, and operation
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Auction prequalification portals, certification and guarantee-of-origin schemes, EPC document control, lender technical advisers, procurement suites, and owner engineering teams
expectations.biggestRisk: Criteria may remain authority- and auction-specific, project financiers already demand evidence, and public qualification/certification rules may absorb the generic layer
